item.title: Canadian Police Refer to Biologically Male School Shooter as 'They'
item.description: Video from a presser on Tuesday's attack on a British Columbia school shows Canadian Police referring to the alleged school shooter as "they." The post Canadian Police Refer to Biologically Male School Shooter as ‘They’ appeared first on Breitbart.

item.title: Republicans Debut 'Nigeria Religious Freedom' Act Demanding Report on U.S. Support for Persecuted Christians
item.description: House Republicans, led by Reps. Chris Smith (R-NJ) and Riley Moore (R-WV), introduced a bill on Monday calling for the State Department to offer comprehensive reports on American actions to protect Christians persecuted by a host jihadist terror threats in Nigeria, as well as efforts to convince the Nigerian government to take the threat seriously. The post Republicans Debut ‘Nigeria Religious Freedom’ Act Demanding Report on U.S. Support for Persecuted Christians appeared first on Breitbart.

item.title: Report: U.S. Will Send 200 Troops to Train Nigerian Military
item.description: According to a U.S. official who spoke to media outlets on Tuesday, the Pentagon will send about 200 troops to Nigeria within the next few weeks to train the Nigerian military in counter-terrorism tactics. The post Report: U.S. Will Send 200 Troops to Train Nigerian Military appeared first on Breitbart.

item.title: Trump Honored on Behalf of Coal Miners as 'Undisputed Champion of Beautiful, Clean Coal'
item.description: WASHINGTON–President Donald Trump was presented with an award on Wednesday, naming him the "undisputed champion of beautiful clean coal," on behalf of coal miners across the country. The post Trump Honored on Behalf of Coal Miners as ‘Undisputed Champion of Beautiful, Clean Coal’ appeared first on Breitbart.

item.title: Exclusive – Secretary Lutnick: Trump Reasserting American Dominance by Ending Countries Taking Advantage of Us
item.description: During a Breitbart News policy discussion on Wednesday, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick described how President Donald Trump’s trade approach is focused on ending decades of foreign economic advantage over the United States, pointing to long-term trade imbalances and the consequences of foreign ownership of U.S. assets. The post Exclusive – Secretary Lutnick: Trump Reasserting American Dominance by Ending Countries Taking Advantage of Us appeared first on Breitbart.
